surface.latex: There is a smooth connected projective complex surface $X$ containing a connected nodal curve $Z_0$ with smooth rational irreducible components such that $\im(\pi_1(Z_0)\to\pi_1(X))$ is infinite. In the simply connected universal cover of $X$, a connected component above $Z_0$ is a closed, connected, noncompact, locally finite union of compact rational curves. The holomorphic hull of any one of its points is noncompact. In particular, this universal cover is not holomorphically convex.
surface.paraphrase: A smooth projective surface whose universal cover contains an infinite connected chain of compact rational curves (an infinite Nori string), so the cover is not holomorphically convex: Shafarevich's holomorphic-convexity conjecture fails in dimension 2.

fourfold.latex: There exist a smooth connected projective complex fourfold $X$ and a simple abelian surface $A\subset X$ such that (1) $X$ has large fundamental group; (2) $\im(\pi_1(A)\to\pi_1(X))\simeq\Z$. The universal cover $\widetilde X$ contains no positive-dimensional compact complex analytic subvariety and is not Stein.
fourfold.paraphrase: A smooth projective fourfold with large pi_1 whose universal cover has no compact positive-dimensional subvarieties yet is not Stein (hence not holomorphically convex): the large-pi_1 (Kollar/Shafarevich 'Stein') form of the conjecture fails too. The obstruction is a closed submanifold C^2/Z^3 ~ T^3 x R of the universal cover, which has H_3 != 0 and so cannot be Stein.

main_statement.relation_between_manuscripts: Independent architectures. The fourfold does not cite the surface and vice versa. The fourfold subsumes 'not holomorphically convex' in dimension 4 and adds the large-pi_1 case; the surface gives dimension 2 (and is the sharp-dimension statement, since curves are trivial). Shared: both realize a known obstruction (Nori string / non-Stein closed submanifold) and the hard part of each is proving that a specific element or subgroup has infinite image in pi_1 of a projective variety whose pi_1 is necessarily non-linear.

headline_corollaries.paraphrase: pi_1 of the surface has no faithful finite-dimensional complex representation (by EKPR linear Shafarevich).
The surface is not special (uses OpenAIAbelianity2026 Cor 1.4, a model-produced result).
Its universal cover is not biholomorphic to a semialgebraic open subset of a projective variety (uses OpenAISemialgebraicCovers2026 Cor 8.1, model-produced).
Via Remmert reduction, the fourfold also disproves holomorphic convexity.

main_statement.note_for_comparator: No Lean. If formalized, natural targets: (S) existence of X, Z_0 with infinite image (topological core: Prop infinite-quotient + Lemma local-detection); (F) Thm cyclic-embedding plus Prop large-reduction.

correctness_audit.verdict: No definite gap found on a full reading of both manuscripts. Both claims are extraordinary (they refute a 1972 conjecture, the second even in Kollar's large-pi_1 form) and unrefereed; several steps are proved in compressed prose that a referee would need to expand. Treat as unverified.
checked: S free ranks: K=1+16*6=97; Pi rank 47; L rank 48; B has 5 punctures, Gamma rank 4. Correct.
S cyclic endpoint estimate (S26): (T'-id)^4=T'^4-id in char 2; T'^3(z_0)=z_3z_2z_2z_1z_2z_1z_1z_0 contains z_3 once as first letter; conclusion nu(w_4)>=d+4 follows. Correct.
S Frattini differential: (1+xi)^{-1}-1=xi+xi^2+xi^3 in char 2; D(l)=l^2 for linear l so D=u^2d_u+v^2d_v in any coordinates; d^2=0; C (+) dC = R. Correct.
S monodromy-raising for weight-2 boundaries: w'w^{-1} in nu>=2 by Lemma degree-one; commutator estimates give nu>=3. Correct.
S Lemma degree-one: chi_j from Y_j^2=q(z)-omega_bar^j s has simple zeros only at the j-pair and an even pole at 0, so basepoint lifts exist; the five characters are a basis of V*. Correct.

F geometry of D: coupling meets slope lambda iff c^2(1+|lambda|^2)<a; with 0.7225<c^2/a<0.81 the four red slopes meet, blue (|lambda|>4) do not; 2c^2>a separates z- and w-couplings; |z_2/z_1|<0.62 on couplings; |z_1|<c where |lambda|>1. Correct.
F Prop large-reduction: rank-loss codimension 3>2 along F; incidence 4c=4d+8 > 4d+6; Lefschetz to dimension 4; largeness case analysis (curves in simple A have finite-index lattice image). Correct.
F Lemma cyclic-upper: product structure near {t=c} x red disk gives one k commuting with h_i; unbranched exceptional meridian kh_i killed; h_5h_6=1. Correct.
F ambient blowdown: N_{E/T}=O(-1)+O(-1) after m-1 blowups (each adds 1 to degree since E^2=-1); G=P^1xP^1 with normal O(-1,-1); contraction of the other ruling smooth. Plausible and standard.
consistency_checks_passed: EKPR (linear Shafarevich, fixed rank N) applied to F: the image of e in pi_1(X)/H_N must be finite for every N (else C^2/Z^3 would be closed in a holomorphically convex space with no compact curves, hence Stein). So some power of the generator dies in every rank-N representation. F's proof uses no representation, consistent; the paper says only that it 'does not require a faithful linear representation', understating that it cannot have one detecting e.
EKPR for S: the infinite image is detected only through finite 2-groups of unbounded size; a fixed-rank EKPR does not see it. No contradiction, and S itself notes pi_1 is non-linear.

Treger (arXiv 1008.1745, unrefereed) claims large + residually finite pi_1 => Stein universal cover. If correct, pi_1 of F's fourfold is not residually finite, consistent with F's remark that no family of finite quotients is used.
Eyssidieux-Funar proved most BK candidates are holomorphically convex; S uses a different (genus-zero, pro-2) family, so no conflict.
residual_concerns: F Lemma app:true-relations is the global crux: every relation of the orbifold pi_1 must close in its starting chart, including transverse disks at fixed loci of sigma-powers away from Gamma.o and at points of Gamma_0.o \ Gamma.o (full pencils, individual charts). The argument is plausible but terse.

F local path criterion (F08): a self-contained re-proof of a Cartan-Hadamard-type theorem with explicit constants; several steps say 'transport of short competitors' or 'standard consequences'. A referee would want this checked against Coulon's or Delzant-Gromov's proof.

F Prop model-hyperbolicity: quasi-isometry between projected-diameter graphs and the cone over the lifted ideal complement I is sketched; the case of points near (lifted) arrangement hyperplanes at infinity and disconnected I components needs care.
S Lemma shift-basis: the T_2 and sigma propagation is an induction stated in two sentences each.
S extends to the pro-2 completion of Gamma and uses 'union of M_N topologically generates D_J'; standard but unproved.
S cites OpenAISemialgebraicCovers2026 (dated Sept 24) from a Sept 23 preprint: a chronology artefact suggesting co-development or later revision; corollary-only.
Both: extraordinary claims with no human review recorded; the conjecture had been widely expected to be hard; neither manuscript cites the other, so the release offers no internal cross-check.
